results.note: the apply is fed blocks[-1] (the raw last fenced block) instead of hunked[-1] (the last block that actually carries a hunk) -- this is the literal 0.6.8 defect the unit fixes: when the last block is a hunkless snippet, the wrong text goes to git apply.
picks the FIRST hunked block instead of the last -- if a model offers a false-start hunk followed by its real corrected hunk, the stale first one applies instead of the model's final answer.
loosens the hunk detector from an anchored '^@@ ' line match to a bare substring test -- a block that merely mentions '@@' in prose text (not as a real hunk header) would now count as hunked.
the empty-diff detector is short-circuited to always-true, so the 'elif reasons and not empty' refusal can never fire no matter what a hunkless block actually contains.

the empty-diff detector is short-circuited to always-false, so a truly empty/headers-only reply with declared edits now wrongly triggers the refusal instead of the pre-existing 'nothing to change' outcome (the C2 fixture's case).
drops the not-empty guard from the refusal condition -- a truly empty/headers-only reply that still declared edits now refuses instead of reporting nothing to change.
drops the reasons guard from the refusal condition -- any non-empty snippet-only reply now refuses even when the model declared no edits at all.

the refusal path sets deep-empty instead of deep-failed (while still building the refusal's error text) -- a snippet-only reply the model says edited something now reads as a clean no-change outcome, with the explanatory error never surfaced by the deep-empty branch.
